The transfer cleanly improves things. Wood out and Watkins in nets 6.4 points, with no hit to pay—you have the free transfer available and enough in the bank. Watkins replaces a struggling bench forward with one who projects higher and will push into your squad's competitive depth.

Make the Wood-to-Watkins swap and play this eleven.
